source.name: Tanzil Quran metadata (classification and revelation order)

period.heading: Period of Revelation
period.text: According to Hadrat Abdullah bin Abbas, this Surah was sent down after Surah An-Naba. Its subject matter also testifies that it belongs to the earliest period at Makkah.

source.name: Sayyid Abul A'la Mawdudi, Tafhim al-Qur'an (introduction to the surah)

theme.heading: Theme and Subject Matter
theme.text: Its theme is affirmation of Resurrection and the life hereafter; It also warns of the consequences of belying the Messenger of God.

source.name: Sayyid Abul A'la Mawdudi, Tafhim al-Qur'an (introduction to the surah)
